Responsibilities
Analyze experimental and operational bioanalytical datasets
Support development of automated tools for data review, visualization, and reporting
Assist with assay performance investigations and trend analyses
Collaborate with scientists across molecular, immunological, and cell-based assay platforms
Prepare technical summaries and presentations of project findings
Present project outcomes at the end-of-summer intern symposium
